svg.title: Gray Curve Relief
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for gray, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-reliefs-2009-2010-02-2011/lightbox/works/gray-curve-relief-2010-33754; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
